issues.message: The load time for the homepage is relatively high (646 ms) compared to the other pages. Consider optimizing images, minifying CSS and JavaScript, and leveraging browser caching to improve homepage performance. (Recommendation
issues.recommendation: Use image optimization tools, minify CSS and JavaScript files, and configure browser caching.)

insights: The Time to First Byte (TTFB) is within acceptable limits for all pages, indicating that the server is responding quickly.
First Contentful Paint (FCP) is also within acceptable limits for all pages, suggesting that the browser is rendering the first piece of content quickly.

The duration of the tests varies, with the "How It Works" page having the shortest duration. This could indicate that the page has fewer resources or that the test environment may have experienced issues during the test.
